name: static-landing
title: Nordwind Coffee Roasters — static landing page
description: Marketing landing page for a fictional Bergen coffee roastery. Pure HTML5 + CSS + vanilla JS with no build step and no npm; served by nginx with gzip, cache headers and a custom 404.
persistence: none (fully static; contact form is client-side only and posts nowhere)
notes: No build step. Serve the folder root as document root. nginx.conf maps unknown paths to the custom 404.html; python http.server (serve.sh) does not.
